name: 08079 · Salem, NJ
findings: ZIP 08079 (Salem) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08079 (Salem) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08079 (Salem) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
